lorelei: From her home, Lorelei wandered as a child into a network of caves. A Harpy Hag found and raised her there; Lorelei has no memory of her real parents. Shortly before the invasion of Erathia, she volunteered to serve the Dungeon Overlords.
ajit: Ajit carefully studied the works of Agar, the foolish Wizard and scientist of Enroth, who accidentally created the Beholders and the Evil Eyes which Ajit now commands, training a 'better breed' to be used in combat.
gunnar: Gunnar served as a Dungeon Overlord scout, then as guide and bodyguard to several high-ranking officials. He was eventually given command of a garrison on rugged Nighon's borders. What he lacks in brains, he makes up for in instinct.
jeddite: Some say Jeddite has seen Zenofex's face. Others argue that if Jeddite is still alive, the rumor cannot possibly be true. He has never confirmed or denied the story, leaving the question unanswered and the rumor alive.
geon: Geon can see into the minds of other spellcasters, reading their thoughts as they invoke their powers. In many cases, he learns to cast those spells himself. This ability accounts for much of his magical skill as a Warlock.
deemer: As a young adult, Deemer's magical ability was so far out of control that he nearly had to be killed; it threatened both himself and those around him. He has since learned to control his powers and is more than a formidable foe in combat.
sephinroth: Sephinroth claims to be King Gryphonheart's illegitimate daughter. His refusal to acknowledge her has fueled her hatred of Erathia's throne, which she hopes one day to claim. She joined the Warlocks and is the only known woman to bear that title.
darkstorn: Darkstorn challenged his way through Nighon's warrior ranks, secretly using magic to make sure he won. Once he had gained a position of power, he revealed his true abilities. Since that revelation, none have challenged him again.
